page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top: page number "6" left, title "LAMENTATIONES" right. Below it, one block of verse in three stanzas, then a rule. Below the rule, a centred heading "DALETH. HE. VAV." and one stanza of verse with a drop initial. A second stanza and a third stanza follow. The catchword sits at the lower right. No margin notes.

l.i: Rident amici cladibus obrutam Durisque tristem ludibriis petunt: Fœdusque iuratum renellens[?] Turba mouet sociata bellum. Sic Juda cunctis nunc minor hostibus Lustrare Phœbo cogitur altero Terras calentes, & ferocis Arbitrium sequitur Tyranni. Sedes remotas nunc miser incolit Mixtus profanis gentibus aduena: Quem dirus angustis vagantem Temporibus premit usque victor.
DESERTA nunc gemit via Qua duxit ante floridum Syonis ad montem sacræ Choros piorum nobiles.
Nunc prisca festo tempore Nemo requirit atria, Nec unus villis urbibus Civis relictus cernitur.
Languet Sacerdos anxius: Lugent tenella virgines: Dolorq; sævus intimis Latet medullis abditus.
